name: The Bucket Orchestra
prompt: Balance giant tipping buckets at successive heights around a water-play court. One spills into the next while children pump the first bucket from a low brass handle.

name: The Wave Library
prompt: Build three narrow wave pools with different paddle shapes exposed behind glass. Bathers ride the broadest wave while spectators compare the ripples along a common promenade.

name: The Corkscrew Raft
prompt: Send round family rafts down an open spiral flume. A chain lift returns the empty rafts beside the launch stair, showing the whole cycle in a compact footprint.

name: The Umbrella Rain Room
prompt: Cover a shallow splash pool with overlapping metal parasols. Water spills from one rim to the next while children open and close small gates along the edge.

name: A River You Can Pedal
prompt: Make a loop of shallow moving water around a pedal-powered pump house. Visitors pedal side by side while floating rings drift past planted banks and a low boarding step.
